title: Akai Ito

routes.title: 千羽烏月ルート
routes.notes: Senba Uzuki (千羽烏月, VNDB c10500). Reachable from the start and the first heroine route in the recommended order. True End is『爽やかな立ち風』（ED32）; alternate endings are ED3/13/28/29/30/31. The current route text is reconciled against the HD-target Set-A walkthrough and directly inspectable Foxtail red3 Set B; historical Saomix material is provenance only. HD-target correction (2026-09-19): the day-1 route branch uses『わたしはこくりと頷いた』, supported by the HD-target walkthrough and Foxtail red3; the older XNEO『わたしは首を横に振る』variant is not used for this target.

routes.title: 若杉葛ルート
routes.notes: Wakasugi Tsuzura (若杉葛, VNDB c10498). The route's True End『彼岸の花をつかまえて』（ED12）requires first seeing ED11. The HD-target walkthrough documents the target-specific action text and save/recovery sequences; Foxtail red2 independently covers the main route and ED2/6-12 branch conditions. This route also satisfies the Tsuzura-side Nozomi route-seal condition by choosing『割るのは忍びない』and then reaching an ending. Historical Saomix notes are provenance only and no longer block generation/review.

routes.title: 浅間サクヤルート
routes.notes: Asama Sakuya (浅間サクヤ, VNDB c10499). Recommended after the required Uzuki/Tsuzura unlock work. True End is『ついのときまで』（ED25）; other documented endings are ED4/22-24/26-27. The main route and day-4 recovery use the HD-target walkthrough plus Foxtail red4. The HD-target walkthrough explicitly documents five Sakuya checkpoints; all are represented: global Save14=local①, Save15=local②, Save16=local③, Save17=local④, Save18=local⑤. ED4『雫』 has multiple documented valid routes: the guide uses the target-specific Livedoor replay-from-beginning sequence; Foxtail red6 and other walkthrough material document alternative routes to the same ending rather than an exclusive condition. Because red6 does not independently verify the exact emitted HD-target replay sequence, it is retained as supplementary alternative-path evidence and the ED4 detour's exact Set-B fields use the omission placeholder except for the independently listed ED4 endpoint. ED24 uses target-supported spelling『凍てる孤月』. ED26 classification is explicitly reconciled as Normal End: XNEO labels it Normal and Foxtail presents No.26 with the same normal-ending marker used for ED23/ED27, while the HD-target Livedoor recovery page labels it Bad; the guide therefore uses the XNEO Set-A component for the ED26 terminal classification.

routes.title: ユメイルート
routes.notes: Yumei (ユメイ, VNDB c10497). True End is『白花の咲く頃に』（ED21）; alternate endings are ED1/5/16-20. The route content is reconciled against the HD-target Set-A walkthrough and directly inspectable Foxtail red1 Set B. Yumei must precede Nozomi because the Nozomi route seal requires completing an ending after choosing『だけど彼女たちだって可哀相』; ED18 alone is not the mechanical unlock condition. HD-target correction (2026-09-19): the first-day branch uses『わたしはこくりと頷いた』→『気のせいだと思い込む』, supported by the HD-target walkthrough and Foxtail red1.

routes.title: ノゾミルート
routes.notes: Nozomi (ノゾミ, VNDB c10502). XNEO summarizes the unlock via Yumei ED18, but the HD-target walkthrough and Foxtail red5 document the actual route-seal conditions: complete an ending after Tsuzura-route『割るのは忍びない』and complete an ending after Yumei-route『だけど彼女たちだって可哀相』, opening『赤い縛め / 三日目 / 夜』. The recommended order satisfies both flags before Nozomi. The current HD-target route ends are Bad End『ニ重箱の底で』（ED14）and True End『光は風に』（ED15）. No source designates ED15 as an overarching narrative true ending for the whole game.

sources.title: アカイイト完全攻略 | XNEO
sources.notes: Complete text walkthrough covering all 5 heroine routes. For each route lists: the unlock condition ('攻略条件') if any, the True End name/ED number, and a full day-by-day (1日目～4日目) list of every choice, with every branch to a Bad End or Normal End spelled out as '選択肢 → 選択肢... でBad/Normal End「名前」（EDxx）'. This is the primary source used for exact choice text and ending names/numbers. Fetched directly (not summarized) and stored/reviewed line-by-line; last updated per page footer 2020年6月13日.

sources.title: アカイイト/アカイイトHD REMASTER　攻略まとめ
sources.notes: Set A target-specific component. Directly inspected Japanese walkthrough explicitly covering both the original PS2 game and アカイイト HD REMASTER (Switch/STEAM). It is used for HD-target choice text, numbered save/checkpoint positions, route-seal conditions, and ending-recovery sequences. Where XNEO differs from this HD-target page, the guide reconciles the difference against independent Foxtail Set B rather than silently preferring the older XNEO form.

sources.title: FAQ/アカイイト攻略FAQ - アカイイト/アオイシロ まとめwiki
sources.notes: Partial/supplementary source, not a complete walkthrough on its own. Its FAQ section documents three specific hard-to-find choice sequences that are easy to miss on the branch diagram (烏月ルート「吸血鬼」の左, 烏月ルート「どうしてこんなところに？」の左→左, 葛ルート「コドク」の左, サクヤルート「歓迎の心は掃除から」の左→右), given as full choice chains. These were cross-checked against xneo.jp's day-by-day listings and are consistent. Also confirms there is no single canonical 'grand happy end' bugfix and that a specific ending ('言霊の継承(2)') has a known freeze bug unrelated to route logic. Site required a direct fetch with a browser user-agent (returns HTTP 403 to generic fetchers).

sources.title: アカイイト - ゲームカタログ@Wiki ～名作からクソゲーまで～
sources.notes: Reference/review article, not a choice-by-choice walkthrough. Used to corroborate structural facts: total of 32 endings (5 happy/True Ends, 12 Normal Ends, 15 Bad Ends); confirms only Uzuki's route needs no prior unlock ('ルートの解除をせずにいきなりハッピーエンドに到達出来るのは烏月だけ'); explicitly states there is NO single 'true happy end' among the 5 heroine True Ends ('「真のハッピーエンド」が存在しない...本当の意味でのハッピーエンドが存在しない'), and that the sequel Aoishiro added a 'Grand Happy End' specifically in response to this criticism (implying Akai Ito itself, including the 2023 HD Remaster, was not given one). Also confirms the 2023 Switch/Steam 'AKAIITO HD REMASTER' is a remaster of the same content/routes as the original 2004 PS2 release, with no new routes added. Retrieved via Wayback Machine snapshot (direct fetch returns HTTP 403) at http://web.archive.org/web/20250303014011/https://w.atwiki.jp/gcmatome/pages/4086.html.

sources.title: PS２版「アカイイト」で全てのエンディングを見ました。- ルーファスの日記
sources.notes: Supplementary/opinion source only, not a walkthrough (no choice text). A completionist's blog post about having seen all 32 endings. Notable for a claim that conflicts with the guide's neutral 'no true end' framing: the author personally argues Yumei's True End is 'probably' the game's real true ending because the official drama CD's epilogue continues from a state consistent with her route. This is a personal interpretation, not corroborated by any walkthrough site, and is documented under disagreements rather than used to set is_true_ending on any route.

sources.title: Akai Ito - VNDB entry v98
sources.notes: Reference only. Confirms release history: original PS2 release (2004-08/10), SuperLite 2000 budget re-release (2005), PSN download (2013), and the newest release, 'AKAIITO HD REMASTER' for Nintendo Switch and Steam/PC (2023-05-25), bundled with a HD Remaster of the sequel Aoishiro. The 2023 HD Remaster is the release targeted for this guide per project rules (most recent platform). No evidence found (from VNDB, official site, or the gcmatome retrospective) that the HD Remaster added routes or endings beyond the 2004 original.

sources.title: VNDB Kana API — character list for v98
sources.notes: Reference only, used to obtain exact, non-hallucinated VNDB character IDs and portrait image URLs (queried directly via the API rather than relying on a scraped/summarized page, to avoid transcription errors in image IDs). Confirmed 5 characters with vns.role = 'primary' for v98: Yumei (c10497), Wakasugi Tsuzura (c10498), Asama Sakuya (c10499), Senba Uzuki (c10500), Nozomi (c10502) — these are the 5 heroine routes. Protagonist is Hatou Kei (c10490, role 'main'). Side characters Kei/ケイ (c10507, twin brother, distinct from protagonist despite same reading), Nushi (c10509), Mikage (c10856), and Nara Youko (c91338, no portrait image available) are not route characters.

sources.title: AKAIITO HD REMASTER 攻略
sources.notes: Supplementary target-labeled walkthrough only; not counted as Set A or Set B. It documents yet another valid path to Sakuya ED4『雫』, supporting the conclusion that the differing Livedoor/Foxtail ED4 sequences are alternative solutions rather than mutually exclusive ending conditions.

disagreements: 1) There is no single overarching 'true ending'; each heroine has its own best/True End. 2) Exact Switch-target action text is taken from the HD-target walkthrough where independently corroborated by active Foxtail Set B; older XNEO variants are retained only when specifically resolved in research. 3) Nozomi's mechanical unlock is the Tsuzura/Yumei route-seal pair, not ED18 alone. 4) Historical Saomix material is provenance only. 5) Sakuya ED4 has multiple documented valid routes. The guide emits the target-specific Livedoor replay sequence; Foxtail red6 documents a different alternative path to the same ED4 and is supplementary rather than active verification for that exact detour. 6) ED26『月へ向かう蝶』 has a classification disagreement: XNEO and Foxtail support Normal End, while the HD-target Livedoor page labels it Bad End. The guide resolves ED26 as Normal End and uses the XNEO Set-A component for the terminal classification. 7) ED24 is『凍てる孤月』for the HD target; XNEO's『凍てる弧月』is an older variant.
